title: Timeless
summary: TI'MELESS, adjective Unseasonable; done at an improper time. Nor fits it to prolong the heav'nly feast Timeless-- [Not used.] 1. Untimely; immature; done or suffered before the proper time; as a timel

inlines.v: TI'MELESS, adjective Unseasonable; done at an improper time. Nor fits it to prolong the heav'nly feast Timeless-- [Not used.] 1. Untimely; immature; done or suffered before the proper time; as a timeless grave. [Not used.]
